critical_code_review_comments: LinkGoogleScreen re-runs gis.initialize() in an effect that also mounts a globally-shared GIS instance — the GSI_LOGGER warning ('initialize() is called multiple times') is emitted on the link screen. Benign here (only one instance is active at a time) but worth guarding with a ref if a future screen also calls initialize() during the same session.
